blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 Japan won its seventh consecutive Asian Games softball gold medal Saturday with a 7-0 mercy-rule victory over China, while veteran pitcher Yukiko Ueno capped a remarkable career milestone by being part of all seven title-winning teams. “Honestly, I never imagined I would compete in seven Asian Games,” the 44-year-old Ueno said. “I see this as a gift from God and want to accept it with gratitude.” The two nations met for the second straight day after Japan earned a 7-6 walk-off victory in Friday’s last game of the seven-team […]...
